1. Add Control‑Flow Analysis (Per‑Function Paths)

Why
The static index today knows which functions call which, but not when or under what conditions. Control‑flow graphs (CFGs) give the AI the ability to reason about execution order, loops, and branches inside a single function.

What to collect

    For each function/method, emit a simplified control‑flow skeleton:

        Sequence of calls, with if/else branches marked.

        Loop information (while/for) and recursion hints.

    Store as a small JSON structure per symbol.

How it helps

    AI can answer: “Does reset() always call cleanup() before returning?”

    “What conditions cause handle_timeline_click() to skip updating the plot?”

2. Build a Data‑Flow / Dependency Graph (Variables & Attributes)

Why
You already track attribute writes/reads, but not how values propagate. Data‑flow connects assignments across function boundaries, helping the AI understand what influences a piece of state.

What to collect

    Track assignments to class attributes and module‑level variables.

    When a function returns a value, note which variables it might have read.

    Build a graph of “taint”‑style flow: e.g., self.current_start is set in on_timeline_click() and later read in redraw_plot().

How it helps

    “What affects the amplitude scale value?” → trace back to setters and upstream calculations.

    “Which methods modify the raw EEG data object?” → find all writers.

3. Instrument Qt Signal‑Slot Resolution (Runtime‑only for now)

Why
Static extraction of .connect() calls is heuristic and often misses connections made with string‑based signals, lambda wrappers, or dynamically created objects. The runtime trace already logs some signal firings, but you can enrich it with actual connection maps.

What to collect

    During runtime, use QObject::connect monitoring (e.g., monkey‑patch connect) to log:

        Sender object type + signal name

        Receiver object type + slot name

        File/line where connection was made (if available)

    Store this as a separate signal_connections section in the runtime trace.

How it helps

    AI can answer: “Is eeg_loaded_signal actually connected to anything in this run?”

    “Which slots are triggered when I click the timeline?” → show the live wiring.

4. Add Call‑Stack Context to Runtime Events

Why
Your runtime events currently record the immediate source symbol. Adding a partial call stack gives the AI the sequence of invocations that led to the event—crucial for understanding causality.

What to collect

    When an event is logged, capture the last 5–10 frames of the Python call stack (file, line, function).

    Store as a stack list in the event’s extra field.

How it helps

    “Why did reset_to_initial_eeg_state() run?” → AI can see it was called from closeEvent after a user action.

    “What’s the full path from menu click to topomap redraw?”

5. Integrate Version Control History

Why
Knowing when a file was last changed, who changed it, and why (commit message) can answer questions about deprecated code, bug fixes, and module ownership.

What to collect

    Run git log for each file and extract:

        Last modification date

        Number of commits

        Author(s)

        Commit messages (first line)

    Store in the static index under git_metadata per file.

How it helps

    “Is timeline_manager.py still actively maintained?” → last commit date tells.

    “Why was the reset logic changed?” → pull commit messages.

6. Link to Unit Test Coverage

Why
If a module is covered by tests, the AI can be more confident about its correctness. If it’s untested, the AI can warn about potential fragility.

What to collect

    Run pytest --cov (or your test runner) and map coverage data to files.

    Store per‑file coverage percentage and list of tests that cover it.

How it helps

    “Is the topomap rendering code tested?” → answer with coverage %.

    “Which tests exercise the timeline?” → list them.

7. Perform Natural Language Summarization of Docstrings & Comments

Why
Docstrings and comments contain rich semantic information that the AI can use, but raw text is verbose. A short, deterministic summary (like you already have for symbols) can be improved by extracting key phrases: parameters, return values, side effects, and examples.

What to collect

    For each docstring, extract:

        @param / @return annotations

        “Side effects: …” if mentioned

        One‑line summary via heuristics (e.g., first sentence)

    Store as structured fields.

How it helps

    “What does reset_to_initial_eeg_state return?” → look up structured return info.

    “Does plot_topomap modify any global state?” → check side‑effect annotation.

8. Build a Module‑Level “Responsibility” Summary (AI‑Generated)

Why
Heuristic roles (startup, timeline, etc.) are good, but an LLM can produce a richer, human‑readable summary for each module—if done offline (not at runtime). This can be a one‑time pre‑computation.

What to collect

    For each important module, send its symbol list, imports, and docstrings to a local LLM with a prompt like:
    “Summarize the responsibility of this module in 2–3 sentences.”

    Store the result in the static index.

How it helps

    When the user asks “What does the snapshot module do?”, the AI can directly quote the summary, saving retrieval time.

9. Add Architecture Decision Records (ADR) Parsing

Why
If your project has ADRs (e.g., in docs/decisions/), they explain why certain architectural choices were made. The AI can leverage them for answers about design rationale.

What to collect

    Parse Markdown files that follow a naming pattern like docs/adr/*.md.

    Extract title, date, status, context, decision, and consequences.

    Store in the static index under architectural_decisions.

How it helps

    “Why did we switch from legacy timeline manager to the new one?” → point to the ADR.

    “What are the trade‑offs of the current reset mechanism?” → ADR may have that.

10. Provide a Queryable Interface (e.g., SQLite / GraphQL)

Why
Right now the AI reads JSON files, which is fine for small‑scale retrieval, but for large projects a structured query layer could let the AI ask very specific questions (like “find all classes with a method named update”) without scanning the whole JSON.

What to build

    Convert the static index into an SQLite database with tables: files, symbols, calls, imports, etc.

    Expose a simple API (maybe via a local HTTP server) that the AI can call to run queries.

How it helps

    Enables the AI to do precise, large‑scale reasoning (e.g., “show me all functions that call plot_topomap”).

11. Enhance Runtime Trace with Object Instance Tracking

Why
Your current runtime events know which file/function, but not which object instance (e.g., two different visualizers). This limits the AI’s ability to reason about multiple windows or sessions.

What to collect

    When an object is created, assign a unique instance ID.

    Include that ID in all subsequent events from that object.

    Store object creation events with instance IDs.

How it helps

    “Did the first visualizer get reset before the second one was opened?” → trace instance IDs.

12. Integrate Performance Profiles (Execution Time / Resource Usage)

Why
If you log wall‑clock time for certain operations (e.g., EEG load, topomap render), the AI can answer performance‑related questions.

What to collect

    In the runtime trace, add a duration_ms field for events that represent a complete operation (start/end pair).

    For example, trace the start and end of load_eeg_file(), then compute duration.

How it helps

    “How long does loading an EEG file typically take?” → AI can summarize from runtime traces.

    “Is the topomap rendering slower after the last change?” → compare before/after traces.

13. Add User‑Interaction Flow (Click Sequences)

Why
In a GUI app, many bugs occur in specific sequences of user actions. Logging the high‑level interaction flow (tab switches, button clicks, timeline moves) as a separate stream helps the AI reproduce and diagnose issues.

What to collect

    In the runtime trace, define an interaction event type with details like:

        action (“tab_changed”, “timeline_dragged”, “reset_clicked”)

        target (tab name, time position, etc.)

    Store these in chronological order.

How it helps

    “After switching from Spectrogram to EEG Traces and then dragging the timeline, the amplitude scale resets. Why?” → AI can look at the exact sequence of interaction events.

14. Add Error Recovery & Exception Stack Traces

Why
You already log errors, but capturing full exception traces (with local variables) can give the AI the context to explain why something failed.

What to collect

    In trace_error, include exc_info as a structured object: exception type, message, full stack frames (file, line, function, locals).

How it helps

    “Why does plot_topomap crash when loading a certain file?” → AI can examine the local variables at the crash point (if they are safe to log).

15. Build a Confidence‑Based Answering Layer in V9

Why
With multiple evidence sources (static index, runtime trace, test coverage, etc.), the AI needs to weigh them. Adding a “confidence” field per fact and a set of rules (e.g., “runtime evidence > static evidence”) makes answers more reliable.

What to implement

    In the static index, each role/chain/ownership already has confidence.

    In runtime trace, each event is a fact.

    Extend V9’s prompt builder to explicitly tell the AI:
    “If runtime evidence exists, prefer it. If only static evidence exists, say it’s inferred. If they conflict, report both and note the discrepancy.”

How it helps

    The AI becomes more honest and accurate, reducing hallucinations.

Summary of Next Steps

    High‑impact, low‑effort

        Add call‑stack context to runtime events (item 4).

        Integrate Git metadata (item 5).

        Improve docstring summarization (item 7).

    Medium effort, high gain

        Build signal‑slot resolution (item 3).

        Add test coverage linking (item 6).

        Implement instance tracking (item 11).

        Add user‑interaction flow events (item 13).

    Longer‑term, transformative

        Data‑flow analysis (item 2).

        LLM‑generated module summaries (item 8).

        Queryable SQLite interface (item 10).

        Performance profiling (item 12).

You already have a robust platform; these additions will turn it into a true “project brain” that understands not only structure and runtime behavior, but also evolution, testing, and rationale.

foreach ($file in $files) {

    $content = $content -replace '\bv9_', 'v10_'
    $content = $content -replace '\bV9\b', 'V10'
    Set-Content $file.FullName $content -Encoding UTF8
}

        $content = $content -replace '\bv9_', 'v10_'

Step 1
Add Control-Flow Analysis (Per-Function Paths)

Objetivo arquitetural
Adicionar ao data collector uma extração determinística de fluxo de controle por função, sem mexer ainda no app principal nem no runtime collector.

Arquivos a tocar no Step 1
criar developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_context_collector\collector_control_flow.py
editar developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_context_collector\collector_main.py
editar developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_context_collector\collector_output.py
criar developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_context_collector\tests\test_control_flow.py

Contrato do novo módulo
O novo coletor deve, para cada função/método, produzir uma estrutura pequena e estável, por exemplo:
sequence
lista ordenada de passos simplificados
branches
lista de blocos if/else
loops
lista de loops for/while
returns
quantidade e linhas
recursion_hint
booleano
calls
lista simples de chamadas encontradas

Formato sugerido por símbolo

{
  "control_flow": {
    "sequence": [
      {"type": "call", "name": "cleanup", "line": 10},
      {"type": "if", "line": 11},
      {"type": "call", "name": "update_plot", "line": 12},
      {"type": "return", "line": 15}
    ],
    "branches": [
      {
        "line": 11,

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from collector_ast import parse_python_file
from collector_chains import build_execution_chains
from collector_config import CollectorConfig
from collector_duplicates import find_duplicate_symbols
from collector_output import build_collection_config, build_collector_info
from collector_ownership import build_object_ownership_map
from collector_qt import extract_qt_signal_map
from collector_roles import summarize_file_semantics, summarize_symbol_semantics
from collector_state import build_attribute_state_map
from collector_subsystems import build_subsystem_summaries
from collector_tests import link_tests_to_sources
from collector_utils import normalize_path, safe_json_dump
from collector_walker import walk_python_files_filtered


def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets


def run_collector(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]
        if '__name__ == "__main__"' in joined_source or "QApplication(" in joined_source:
            entry_markers.append("entry_candidate")
            entry_files.append(rel_path)

        file_record = {
            "path": rel_path,
            "module_name": module_name,
            "imports": parsed["imports"],
            "classes": parsed["classes"],
            "functions": parsed["functions"],
            "docstring": docstring,
            "comments": comments,
            "strings": strings,
            "entry_markers": entry_markers,
            "ui_keyword_hits": [],
            "eeg_keyword_hits": [],
            "semantic_hints": semantic["evidence_terms"],
            "semantic_roles": semantic["roles"],
            "primary_role": semantic["primary_role"],
            "secondary_roles": semantic["secondary_roles"],
            "role_confidence": semantic["confidence"],
            "summary": f"{semantic['primary_role']} file" if semantic["primary_role"] else "general python module",
            "source": parsed["source"],
        }
        files_payload.append(file_record)

    symbol_index = _build_symbol_index(files_payload)
    import_graph = _build_import_graph(files_payload)
    call_edges = _build_call_edges(files_payload)
    qt_signal_map = extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload)
    attribute_state_map = build_attribute_state_map(files_payload)
    object_ownership = build_object_ownership_map(files_payload)
    execution_chains = build_execution_chains(files_payload, entry_files)
    subsystems = build_subsystem_summaries(files_payload)
    symbol_summaries = _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload)
    snippet_index = _build_snippet_index(files_payload, config.max_snippet_lines)
    duplicate_symbols = find_duplicate_symbols(files_payload)
    test_links = link_tests_to_sources(files_payload)

    output = {
        "collector_info": build_collector_info(root),
        "project_summary": {
            "project_root": str(root),
            "python_file_count": len(files_payload),
            "entry_file_count": len(entry_files),
            "entry_files": sorted(set(entry_files)),
            "parse_error_count": len(errors),
        },
        "collection_config": build_collection_config(config),
        "files": files_payload,
        "symbol_index": symbol_index,
        "import_graph": import_graph,
        "call_edges": call_edges,
        "keyword_index": {},
        "semantic_roles": {
            record["path"]: {
                "roles": record["semantic_roles"],
                "primary_role": record["primary_role"],
                "secondary_roles": record["secondary_roles"],
                "confidence": record["role_confidence"],
                "evidence_terms": record["semantic_hints"],
            }
            for record in files_payload
        },
        "qt_signal_map": qt_signal_map,
        "attribute_state_map": attribute_state_map,
        "object_ownership": object_ownership,
        "execution_chains": execution_chains,
        "subsystems": subsystems,
        "symbol_summaries": symbol_summaries,
        "snippet_index": snippet_index,
        "duplicate_symbols": duplicate_symbols,
        "test_links": test_links,
        "errors": errors,
    }

    safe_json_dump(output, output_path)
    return output

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(source: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                if value:
                    strings.append(value)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
            functions.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "qualname": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
                    "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
                    "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
                }
            )

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef):
                    methods.append(
                        {
                            "name": item.name,
                            "qualname": node.name + "." + item.name,
                            "lineno": getattr(item, "lineno", None),
                            "docstring": _get_docstring(item),
                            "calls": _extract_calls(item.body),
                            "assignments": _extract_assignments(item.body),
                            "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(item.body),
                        }
                    )

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from typing import Any


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _safe_unparse(node: ast.AST | None) -> str:
    if node is None:
        return ""
    try:
        text = ast.unparse(node)
        return " ".join(text.split())
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _append_unique_call(call_name: str, calls: list[str]) -> None:
    if call_name and call_name not in calls:
        calls.append(call_name)


def _collect_calls_in_nodes(nodes: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node.func)
            _append_unique_call(name, found)
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for node in nodes:
        visitor.visit(node)
    return found


def _collect_simple_statement_calls(stmt: ast.stmt) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(stmt, (ast.If, ast.For, ast.While, ast.Return, ast.Try, ast.With, ast.AsyncWith)):
        return []

    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            call_name = _name_from_node(node.func)
            if call_name:
                calls.append(
                    {
                        "type": "call",
                        "name": call_name,
                        "line": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    Visitor().visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _has_recursion_hint(function_name: str, node: ast.AST) -> bool:
    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self.found = False

        def visit_Call(self, call_node: ast.Call) -> None:
            call_name = _name_from_node(call_node.func)
            if call_name == function_name or call_name.endswith("." + function_name):
                self.found = True
                return
            self.generic_visit(call_node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    visitor.visit(node)
    return visitor.found


def _walk_statements(
    body: list[ast.stmt],
    sequence: list[dict[str, Any]],
    branches: list[dict[str, Any]],
    loops: list[dict[str, Any]],
    returns: list[dict[str, Any]],
    calls: list[str],
) -> None:
    for stmt in body:
        if isinstance(stmt, ast.If):
            sequence.append(
                {
                    "type": "if",
                    "line": getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                }
            )

            body_calls = _collect_calls_in_nodes(stmt.body)
            orelse_calls = _collect_calls_in_nodes(stmt.orelse)

            for name in body_calls:
                _append_unique_call(name, calls)
            for name in orelse_calls:
                _append_unique_call(name, calls)

            branches.append(
                {
                    "line": getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    "has_else": bool(stmt.orelse),
                    "test": _safe_unparse(stmt.test),
                    "body_calls": body_calls,
                    "orelse_calls": orelse_calls,
                }
            )

            _walk_statements(stmt.body, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

            if stmt.orelse:
                else_line = getattr(stmt.orelse[0], "lineno", getattr(stmt, "lineno", None))
                sequence.append(
                    {
                        "type": "else",
                        "line": else_line,
                    }
                )
                _walk_statements(stmt.orelse, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

            continue

        if isinstance(stmt, ast.For):
            sequence.append(
                {
                    "type": "for",
                    "line": getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                }
            )

            body_calls = _collect_calls_in_nodes(stmt.body)
            for name in body_calls:
                _append_unique_call(name, calls)

            loops.append(
                {
                    "type": "for",
                    "line": getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    "target": _safe_unparse(stmt.target),
                    "iter": _safe_unparse(stmt.iter),
                    "body_calls": body_calls,
                }
            )

            _walk_statements(stmt.body, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

            if stmt.orelse:
                _walk_statements(stmt.orelse, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

            continue

        if isinstance(stmt, ast.While):
            sequence.append(
                {
                    "type": "while",
                    "line": getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                }
            )

            body_calls = _collect_calls_in_nodes(stmt.body)
            for name in body_calls:
                _append_unique_call(name, calls)

            loops.append(
                {
                    "type": "while",
                    "line": getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    "test": _safe_unparse(stmt.test),
                    "body_calls": body_calls,
                }
            )

            _walk_statements(stmt.body, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

            if stmt.orelse:
                _walk_statements(stmt.orelse, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

            continue

        if isinstance(stmt, ast.Return):
            line = getattr(stmt, "lineno", None)
            sequence.append(
                {
                    "type": "return",
                    "line": line,
                }
            )
            returns.append({"line": line})

            value_calls = _collect_calls_in_nodes([stmt])
            for name in value_calls:
                _append_unique_call(name, calls)
                sequence.append(
                    {
                        "type": "call",
                        "name": name,
                        "line": line,
                    }
                )
            continue

        simple_calls = _collect_simple_statement_calls(stmt)
        for item in simple_calls:
            sequence.append(item)
            _append_unique_call(item["name"], calls)


def build_control_flow(function_node: ast.AST, function_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = getattr(function_node, "body", [])
    sequence: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    branches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    loops: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    returns: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    calls: list[str] = []

    if isinstance(body, list):
        _walk_statements(body, sequence, branches, loops, returns, calls)

    return {
        "sequence": sequence,
        "branches": branches,
        "loops": loops,
        "returns": returns,
        "calls": calls,
        "recursion_hint": _has_recursion_hint(function_name, function_node),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow
from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(source: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                if value:
                    strings.append(value)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _build_function_record(
    node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
    qualname: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": node.name,
        "qualname": qualname,
        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
        "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
        "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
        "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
        "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
        "control_flow": build_control_flow(node, node.name),
    }


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    function_types = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, function_types):
            functions.append(_build_function_record(node, node.name))

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, function_types):
                    methods.append(_build_function_record(item, node.name + "." + item.name))

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

CURRENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJECT_DIR = CURRENT_DIR.parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow


class TestControlFlow(unittest.TestCase):
    def _build_flow(self, source: str) -> dict:
        module = ast.parse(source)
        function_node = module.body[0]
        return build_control_flow(function_node, function_node.name)

    def test_if_else_and_return_are_captured(self) -> None:
        source = """
def reset(enabled):
    cleanup()
    if enabled:
        update_plot()
    else:
        log_skip()
    return 1
"""
        flow = self._build_flow(source)

        self.assertEqual(flow["calls"], ["cleanup", "update_plot", "log_skip"])
        self.assertEqual(len(flow["branches"]), 1)
        self.assertTrue(flow["branches"][0]["has_else"])
        self.assertEqual(flow["branches"][0]["body_calls"], ["update_plot"])
        self.assertEqual(flow["branches"][0]["orelse_calls"], ["log_skip"])
        self.assertEqual(len(flow["returns"]), 1)

    def test_for_loop_is_captured(self) -> None:
        source = """
def process(items):
    for item in items:
        handle(item)
"""
        flow = self._build_flow(source)

        self.assertEqual(len(flow["loops"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(flow["loops"][0]["type"], "for")
        self.assertEqual(flow["loops"][0]["target"], "item")
        self.assertEqual(flow["loops"][0]["iter"], "items")
        self.assertEqual(flow["loops"][0]["body_calls"], ["handle"])

    def test_recursion_hint_is_captured(self) -> None:
        source = """
def visit(node):
    if node:
        visit(node.child)
    return None
"""
        flow = self._build_flow(source)

        self.assertTrue(flow["recursion_hint"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from collector_ast import parse_python_file
from collector_chains import build_execution_chains
from collector_config import CollectorConfig
from collector_duplicates import find_duplicate_symbols
from collector_output import build_collection_config, build_collector_info
from collector_ownership import build_object_ownership_map
from collector_qt import extract_qt_signal_map
from collector_roles import summarize_file_semantics, summarize_symbol_semantics
from collector_state import build_attribute_state_map
from collector_subsystems import build_subsystem_summaries
from collector_tests import link_tests_to_sources
from collector_utils import normalize_path, safe_json_dump
from collector_walker import walk_python_files_filtered


def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets


def run_collector(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]
        if '__name__ == "__main__"' in joined_source or "QApplication(" in joined_source:
            entry_markers.append("entry_candidate")
            entry_files.append(rel_path)

        file_record = {
            "path": rel_path,
            "module_name": module_name,
            "imports": parsed["imports"],
            "classes": parsed["classes"],
            "functions": parsed["functions"],
            "docstring": docstring,
            "comments": comments,
            "strings": strings,
            "entry_markers": entry_markers,
            "ui_keyword_hits": [],
            "eeg_keyword_hits": [],
            "semantic_hints": semantic["evidence_terms"],
            "semantic_roles": semantic["roles"],
            "primary_role": semantic["primary_role"],
            "secondary_roles": semantic["secondary_roles"],
            "role_confidence": semantic["confidence"],
            "summary": f"{semantic['primary_role']} file" if semantic["primary_role"] else "general python module",
            "source": parsed["source"],
        }
        files_payload.append(file_record)

    symbol_index = _build_symbol_index(files_payload)
    import_graph = _build_import_graph(files_payload)
    call_edges = _build_call_edges(files_payload)
    qt_signal_map = extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload)
    attribute_state_map = build_attribute_state_map(files_payload)
    object_ownership = build_object_ownership_map(files_payload)
    execution_chains = build_execution_chains(files_payload, entry_files)
    subsystems = build_subsystem_summaries(files_payload)
    symbol_summaries = _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload)
    snippet_index = _build_snippet_index(files_payload, config.max_snippet_lines)
    duplicate_symbols = find_duplicate_symbols(files_payload)
    test_links = link_tests_to_sources(files_payload)

    output = {
        "collector_info": build_collector_info(root),
        "project_summary": {
            "project_root": str(root),
            "python_file_count": len(files_payload),
            "entry_file_count": len(entry_files),
            "entry_files": sorted(set(entry_files)),
            "parse_error_count": len(errors),
        },
        "collection_config": build_collection_config(config),
        "files": files_payload,
        "symbol_index": symbol_index,
        "import_graph": import_graph,
        "call_edges": call_edges,
        "keyword_index": {},
        "semantic_roles": {
            record["path"]: {
                "roles": record["semantic_roles"],
                "primary_role": record["primary_role"],
                "secondary_roles": record["secondary_roles"],
                "confidence": record["role_confidence"],
                "evidence_terms": record["semantic_hints"],
            }
            for record in files_payload
        },
        "qt_signal_map": qt_signal_map,
        "attribute_state_map": attribute_state_map,
        "object_ownership": object_ownership,
        "execution_chains": execution_chains,
        "subsystems": subsystems,
        "symbol_summaries": symbol_summaries,
        "snippet_index": snippet_index,
        "duplicate_symbols": duplicate_symbols,
        "test_links": test_links,
        "errors": errors,
    }

    safe_json_dump(output, output_path)
    return output

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(source: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                if value:
                    strings.append(value)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
            functions.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "qualname": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
                    "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
                    "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
                }
            )

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef):
                    methods.append(
                        {
                            "name": item.name,
                            "qualname": node.name + "." + item.name,
                            "lineno": getattr(item, "lineno", None),
                            "docstring": _get_docstring(item),
                            "calls": _extract_calls(item.body),
                            "assignments": _extract_assignments(item.body),
                            "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(item.body),
                        }
                    )

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QFileDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from collector_main import run_collector


DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(r"/")
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON = (
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT
    / "DEVELOPER TOOLS"
    / "FULL_INSPECTOR_JSON_APP"
    / "reasoner_context_collector"
    / "project_structure_index_v11.json"
)


class CollectorRunnerWindow(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project Reasoner V10 Data Collector")
        self.resize(900, 500)

        self.project_root_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT))
        self.output_json_edit = QLineEdit(str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON))

        self.browse_project_button = QPushButton("Browse Project")
        self.browse_output_button = QPushButton("Browse Output")
        self.run_button = QPushButton("Run Collector")

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Project root:"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.project_root_edit, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_project_button, 0, 2)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("Output JSON:"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.output_json_edit, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.browse_output_button, 1, 2)

        button_row = QHBoxLayout()
        button_row.addStretch()
        button_row.addWidget(self.run_button)

        main_layout.addLayout(grid)
        main_layout.addLayout(button_row)
        main_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Log:"))
        main_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.browse_project_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_project_root)
        self.browse_output_button.clicked.connect(self._browse_output_json)
        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self._run_collector)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def _browse_project_root(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Select project root",
            self.project_root_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_ROOT),
        )
        if folder:
            self.project_root_edit.setText(folder)

    def _browse_output_json(self) -> None:
        file_path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Select output JSON",
            self.output_json_edit.text().strip() or str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_JSON),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if file_path:
            self.output_json_edit.setText(file_path)

    def _run_collector(self) -> None:
        project_root = Path(self.project_root_edit.text().strip()).expanduser().resolve()
        output_json = Path(self.output_json_edit.text().strip()).expanduser().resolve()

        if not project_root.exists():
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Invalid project root",
                "Project root does not exist:\n" + str(project_root),
            )
            return

        output_json.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        self.log_box.clear()
        self._append_log("Running collector...")
        self._append_log("Project root: " + str(project_root))
        self._append_log("Output JSON: " + str(output_json))

        try:
            result = run_collector(str(project_root), str(output_json))
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Collector failed",
                str(exc),
            )
            self._append_log("Collector failed:")
            self._append_log(str(exc))
            return

        self._append_log("")
        self._append_log("Collector finished.")
        self._append_log("Project root: " + result["project_summary"]["project_root"])
        self._append_log("Python files: " + str(result["project_summary"]["python_file_count"]))
        self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(result["project_summary"]["entry_file_count"]))
        self._append_log("Parse errors: " + str(result["project_summary"]["parse_error_count"]))
        self._append_log("Output JSON: " + str(output_json))

        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Done",
            "Collector finished successfully.\n\nOutput:\n" + str(output_json),
        )


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = CollectorRunnerWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from typing import Any


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
        return _name_from_node(node.value)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _safe_unparse(node: ast.AST | None) -> str:
    if node is None:
        return ""
    try:
        return " ".join(ast.unparse(node).split())
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _append_unique(value: str, items: list[str]) -> None:
    if value and value not in items:
        items.append(value)


def _extract_reads_from_expr(node: ast.AST | None) -> list[str]:
    reads: list[str] = []

    if node is None:
        return reads

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Name(self, name_node: ast.Name) -> None:
            if isinstance(name_node.ctx, ast.Load):
                _append_unique(name_node.id, reads)
            self.generic_visit(name_node)

        def visit_Attribute(self, attr_node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            if isinstance(attr_node.ctx, ast.Load):
                name = _name_from_node(attr_node)
                _append_unique(name, reads)
            self.generic_visit(attr_node)

    Visitor().visit(node)
    return reads


def _extract_write_targets(target_node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
    targets: list[str] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Name(self, name_node: ast.Name) -> None:
            if isinstance(name_node.ctx, (ast.Store, ast.Del)):
                _append_unique(name_node.id, targets)
            self.generic_visit(name_node)

        def visit_Attribute(self, attr_node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            if isinstance(attr_node.ctx, (ast.Store, ast.Del)):
                name = _name_from_node(attr_node)
                _append_unique(name, targets)
            self.generic_visit(attr_node)

        def visit_Subscript(self, sub_node: ast.Subscript) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(sub_node)
            if name:
                _append_unique(name, targets)
            self.generic_visit(sub_node)

    Visitor().visit(target_node)
    return targets


def _record_dependency(
    dependencies: list[dict[str, Any]],
    target: str,
    sources: list[str],
    line: int | None,
    expr: str,
) -> None:
    if not target:
        return
    dependencies.append(
        {
            "target": target,
            "sources": sources,
            "line": line,
            "expr": expr,
        }
    )


def build_data_flow(function_node: ast.AST) -> dict[str, Any]:
    reads: list[str] = []
    writes: list[str] = []
    return_reads: list[str] = []
    dependencies: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    module_writes: list[str] = []
    attribute_writes: list[str] = []

    body = getattr(function_node, "body", [])
    if not isinstance(body, list):
        body = []

    for stmt in ast.walk(function_node):
        if isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)

            for target_node in stmt.targets:
                targets = _extract_write_targets(target_node)
                for target in targets:
                    _append_unique(target, writes)
                    if "." in target:
                        _append_unique(target, attribute_writes)
                    else:
                        _append_unique(target, module_writes)
                    _record_dependency(
                        dependencies,
                        target,
                        sources,
                        getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                        _safe_unparse(stmt.value),
                    )

        elif isinstance(stmt, ast.AnnAssign):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)

            targets = _extract_write_targets(stmt.target)
            for target in targets:
                _append_unique(target, writes)
                if "." in target:
                    _append_unique(target, attribute_writes)
                else:
                    _append_unique(target, module_writes)
                _record_dependency(
                    dependencies,
                    target,
                    sources,
                    getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    _safe_unparse(stmt.value),
                )

        elif isinstance(stmt, ast.AugAssign):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            target_reads = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.target)
            for source in sources + target_reads:
                _append_unique(source, reads)

            targets = _extract_write_targets(stmt.target)
            for target in targets:
                _append_unique(target, writes)
                if "." in target:
                    _append_unique(target, attribute_writes)
                else:
                    _append_unique(target, module_writes)
                _record_dependency(
                    dependencies,
                    target,
                    sources + target_reads,
                    getattr(stmt, "lineno", None),
                    _safe_unparse(stmt.value),
                )

        elif isinstance(stmt, ast.Return):
            sources = _extract_reads_from_expr(stmt.value)
            for source in sources:
                _append_unique(source, reads)
                _append_unique(source, return_reads)

    return {
        "reads": reads,
        "writes": writes,
        "return_reads": return_reads,
        "attribute_writes": attribute_writes,
        "module_writes": module_writes,
        "dependencies": dependencies,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from collector_control_flow import build_control_flow
from collector_data_flow import build_data_flow
from collector_utils import compact_whitespace, safe_read_text


def _get_docstring(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    try:
        return ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _extract_comments_and_strings(source: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    comments: list[str] = []
    strings: list[str] = []

    for line in source.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            comments.append(stripped)

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                value = compact_whitespace(node.value)
                if value:
                    strings.append(value)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return comments, strings


def _name_from_node(node: ast.AST) -> str:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        base = _name_from_node(node.value)
        return base + "." + node.attr if base else node.attr
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        return _name_from_node(node.func)
    return ""


def _extract_calls(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Call(self, node: ast.Call) -> None:
            calls.append(
                {
                    "call_name": _name_from_node(node.func),
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                }
            )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return calls


def _extract_assignments(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Assign(self, node: ast.Assign) -> None:
            for target in node.targets:
                target_name = _name_from_node(target)
                if target_name:
                    items.append(
                        {
                            "target": target_name,
                            "value_type": type(node.value).__name__,
                            "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                        }
                    )
            self.generic_visit(node)

        def visit_AnnAssign(self, node: ast.AnnAssign) -> None:
            target_name = _name_from_node(node.target)
            if target_name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "target": target_name,
                        "value_type": type(node.value).__name__ if node.value else "",
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _extract_attribute_reads(body: list[ast.stmt]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    class Visitor(ast.NodeVisitor):
        def visit_Attribute(self, node: ast.Attribute) -> None:
            name = _name_from_node(node)
            if name:
                items.append(
                    {
                        "attribute": name,
                        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    }
                )
            self.generic_visit(node)

    visitor = Visitor()
    for stmt in body:
        visitor.visit(stmt)
    return items


def _build_function_record(
    node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef,
    qualname: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": node.name,
        "qualname": qualname,
        "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
        "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
        "calls": _extract_calls(node.body),
        "assignments": _extract_assignments(node.body),
        "attribute_reads": _extract_attribute_reads(node.body),
        "control_flow": build_control_flow(node, node.name),
        "data_flow": build_data_flow(node),
    }


def parse_python_file(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        source = safe_read_text(path)
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, str(exc)

    comments, strings = _extract_comments_and_strings(source)

    module_docstring = _get_docstring(tree)
    imports: list[str] = []
    classes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    functions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    function_types = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                imports.append(alias.name)

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            module_name = node.module or ""
            imports.append(module_name)

        elif isinstance(node, function_types):
            functions.append(_build_function_record(node, node.name))

        elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
            methods: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            bases = [_name_from_node(base) for base in node.bases]

            for item in node.body:
                if isinstance(item, function_types):
                    methods.append(_build_function_record(item, node.name + "." + item.name))

            classes.append(
                {
                    "name": node.name,
                    "lineno": getattr(node, "lineno", None),
                    "docstring": _get_docstring(node),
                    "bases": bases,
                    "methods": methods,
                }
            )

    payload = {
        "module_docstring": module_docstring,
        "imports": sorted(set(filter(None, imports))),
        "classes": classes,
        "functions": functions,
        "comments": comments,
        "strings": strings,
        "source": source,
    }
    return payload, None
